# pscat

> pscat is a PostScript interpreter written in Rust, for practical documents (charts, typed letters and memos, handwritten notes, certificates, multi-page PDFs) and for creative art (generative patterns, watercolor and oil paint, printmaking, chalkboards, display type). It renders PostScript and EPS to PNG, SVG and PDF from a command-line tool, as a Rust library, in the browser and Node as WebAssembly, and through an MCP server and agent plugin. Output is exact and repeatable: the same program and seed give the same picture, and a program is source you can diff, edit and re-render.

Install the command-line tool with `cargo install pscat`, which installs both `pscat` and the `pscat-mcp` server. Or download a ready-built binary for macOS, Linux or Windows from the releases page (no Rust needed). Then `pscat --png out.png some_file.ps` renders a file (`--svg` and `--pdf` also work). `pscat fonts install` adds the full font catalog. For JavaScript, `npm install pscat` gives the WebAssembly renderer for browsers and Node. For a coding agent, the Claude Code plugin installs with `/plugin install pscat --marketplace PSCatLabs/pscat` and the Codex plugin with `codex plugin marketplace add PSCatLabs/pscat` then `codex plugin add pscat@pscat`. Any other MCP client can run `pscat mcp` over stdio. A hosted MCP server is planned (epic #689) and does not exist yet. As a Rust library, add the `pscat` crate with `default-features = false` (see the Rust library guide below). To try pscat with nothing installed, open the playground.

Links below are to the Markdown sources in the repository (raw files, easy to read as text), and to site pages where no Markdown exists.

## Getting started

- [Getting started](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/PSCatLabs/pscat/main/docs/guides/getting-started.md): build or install pscat, the command-line flags, the live window, and PNG, SVG and PDF output
- [When to use pscat](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/PSCatLabs/pscat/main/docs/guides/when-to-use-pscat.md): pscat, an image model, or an LLM drawing on its own; what each does best, with a decision table
- [Playground](https://pscatlabs.github.io/pscat/playground.html): run PostScript in the browser with nothing installed
- [Learn PostScript](https://pscatlabs.github.io/pscat/learn.html): a short tour of the language with runnable examples, for readers new to PostScript
- [Releases](https://github.com/PSCatLabs/pscat/releases): ready-built binaries for macOS, Linux and Windows

## Guides

Open the guide that matches the job.

- [Charts and plots](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/PSCatLabs/pscat/main/docs/guides/charts.md): function plots, surfaces, and bar, line, area, pie and scatter charts for papers and documents, as PNG, SVG or PDF
- [Handwriting](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/PSCatLabs/pscat/main/docs/guides/handwriting.md): a string in, a handwriting-style note, card or caption out (`pscat handwrite`), and the `/HandScript` font
- [Style packs and page templates](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/PSCatLabs/pscat/main/docs/guides/style-packs-and-templates.md): five ready-made page templates (card, letter, certificate, invitation, poster) and four aesthetics, for documents that print as vector PDF
- [Typewritten letters and memos](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/PSCatLabs/pscat/main/plugin/skills/pscat/references/typewriter.md): typed pages with `pscat typewrite`, including an aged "released document" look
- [Fonts](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/PSCatLabs/pscat/main/docs/guides/fonts.md): the display faces, the typewriter for typed letters and memos, and the font catalog
- [Lettering, headlines and apparel](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/PSCatLabs/pscat/main/docs/guides/lettering.md): display type with textured fills, headline layout, shirts and jerseys
- [QR codes](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/PSCatLabs/pscat/main/docs/guides/qr-codes.md): encode a URL or other text as a QR symbol drawn as vector geometry that scans from PNG, SVG and PDF
- [artkit](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/PSCatLabs/pscat/main/docs/guides/artkit.md): the generative-art toolkit (randomness, palettes, turtle graphics, L-systems, path brushes, tilings, fractals, flow fields, scatter)
- [Painting](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/PSCatLabs/pscat/main/docs/guides/painting.md): variable-width brushes, wash and watercolor
- [Landscape cookbook](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/PSCatLabs/pscat/main/docs/guides/landscape-cookbook.md): how to paint each element of a landscape
- [Printmaking and etching](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/PSCatLabs/pscat/main/docs/guides/printmaking.md): engraving, hatching, stipple, halftone, woodcut and linocut
- [Dry media](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/PSCatLabs/pscat/main/docs/guides/dry-media.md): chalk, crayon, charcoal, single-stroke glyphs, and LaTeX math on a chalkboard (`pscat chalk`)
- [Functional PostScript](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/PSCatLabs/pscat/main/docs/guides/functional.md): map, filter and fold over lists of records, composed procedures, and wrappers that count or trace calls
- [Compiled per-pixel kernels](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/PSCatLabs/pscat/main/docs/guides/kernels.md): `kernelimage` and `kernelarray` compile a per-pixel PostScript procedure to native code on every core, byte for byte what the interpreter gives, for ray tracers, fractals, noise landscapes and image filters
- [pscat with an image model](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/PSCatLabs/pscat/main/docs/guides/pscat-with-image-models.md): the image model paints the background once, pscat sets the exact layer on top
- [All guides](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/PSCatLabs/pscat/main/docs/guides/README.md): the index of the guides, grouped by topic

## Agents and MCP

- [pscat for AI agents](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/PSCatLabs/pscat/main/docs/guides/agents.md): the skills, the `pscat-mcp` server and its tools, how to register it, and which tool does which job
- [Plugin README](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/PSCatLabs/pscat/main/plugin/README.md): installing the Claude Code and Codex plugin, requirements, example prompts and privacy
- [pscat skill](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/PSCatLabs/pscat/main/plugin/skills/pscat/SKILL.md): the tool reference for rendering, debugging, handwriting, typed pages and chalkboard math
- [psart skill](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/PSCatLabs/pscat/main/plugin/skills/psart/SKILL.md): the render-look-refine loop for generative art, painting, dry media and style packs
- [psviz skill](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/PSCatLabs/pscat/main/plugin/skills/psviz/SKILL.md): paper-ready function plots and bar, line, area, scatter and pie charts
- [functional-postscript skill](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/PSCatLabs/pscat/main/plugin/skills/functional-postscript/SKILL.md): data-in, marks-out PostScript, and wrappers that count or trace procedure calls
- [Art capabilities catalog](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/PSCatLabs/pscat/main/docs/dev/CAPABILITIES.md): the machine-readable inventory of fonts, palettes, templates and procedures behind `pscat --capabilities` and the `describe_art_capabilities` tool

## JavaScript and Rust

- [pscat on npm](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/PSCatLabs/pscat/main/npm/README.md): the WebAssembly renderer for browsers and Node, to render a page or watch a program draw
- [pscat in the browser](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/PSCatLabs/pscat/main/docs/guides/browser.md): the WebAssembly build and a JavaScript quick start
- [The JavaScript library](https://pscatlabs.github.io/pscat/javascript.html): the dependency-free ES module behind the playground
- [pscat as a Rust library](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/PSCatLabs/pscat/main/docs/guides/library.md): the crate's API, its `window` feature, the supported builds and the stability policy

## Gallery

- [Gallery](https://pscatlabs.github.io/pscat/gallery.html): finished pieces, each drawn by a PostScript program with a "View source" window
- [Font specimens](https://pscatlabs.github.io/pscat/fonts.html): a specimen of every font
- [Gallery notes](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/PSCatLabs/pscat/main/gallery/README.md): how the gallery pieces are made and organised
